text:
ana: Noticed a spike of TLS handshakes failing in ap-northeast after the cipher-whitelist rollout last night. Success down to ~79% on proxy-ap-northeast. Anyone on cipher policy or keystore changes?

ops-bot: ALERT: tls.handshake_failure_rate service=proxy-ap-northeast window=20m value=21% runbook=eng-security/tls-hardening

vik: I rolled out the new TLS profile to enforce TLS1.3-only and AEAD ciphers at 02:00 UTC as part of the hardening ticket infra/tls-2026-03-20. That should be safe but could break older clients or proxies. I didn't touch KMS.

mona: Logs show a mixture of `unsupported_cipher` and `kms.UnwrapError` in different nodes. Snippets: 
```
2026-03-24T02:18:03Z proxy-ap-northeast auth=mtls handshake_ok=false err="tls: unsupported cipher suite" client=service-legacy
2026-03-24T02:18:04Z proxy-ap-northeast auth=mtls handshake_ok=false err="kms.UnwrapError: permission denied" key=projects/redwood/locations/asia-northeast1/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-rot
```

ana: So two simultaneous issues: cipher policy broke some older services, and some nodes couldn't unwrap certs. Could a canary or deployment ordering have caused keystore to rotate before KMS IAM bindings propagated?

vik: We did a fast canary (3 nodes) then fleet. The keystore rotation job was scheduled at 01:55 UTC and the TLS profile rollout started at 02:00 UTC. Might be a race. The rotation created a new ephemeral key name (typo) and the IAM copy step failed in the job runbook.

mona: That explains unwrap errors. For the cipher errors, legacy internal clients still using older TLS stacks are failing. We need a mitigation plan:
- revert TLS profile to allow the legacy suites temporarily, or
- roll back keystore rotation IAM issue, or
- short-lived change: switch proxy KEY_SOURCE to fallback-keystore so unwrap is not needed.

ana: Compliance: we lowered audit sampling for TLS events to 20% in the same maintenance window to reduce noise. That reduces our ability to prove coverage. Please note for the incident log.

compliance-bot: POLICY: If mtls telemetry coverage <95% for >10m for customer-affecting regions, notify security-lead and legal.

vik: Quick actions: 1) I'll trigger the IAM fix for the new key (canary) to restore decrypt to proxy-keystore SA; 2) Mona can patch the TLS profile to re-add one legacy cipher for 1 hour to restore connectivity while we validate.

mona: Patch commands: 
`gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/asia-northeast1/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-rot --member="serviceAccount:proxy-keystore@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"`
`kubectl patch cm proxy-tls-profile -n proxy --patch '{"data":{"cipher_suites":"AEAD_CHACHA20_POLY1305:AEAD_AES_128_GCM:LEGACY_AES_256_GCM"}}'`

(5m)

vik: Canary IAM fix reports unwrap OK on canary node, no kms errors.

mona: After reverting the tls profile on canary, legacy clients resumed and overall success rate climbed to 94% in ap-northeast.

ana: Opening INC-2026-058. Root cause: rotation job created key resource with missing IAM copy; secondary cause: simultaneous enforcement of strict TLS profile; contributing: lowered audit sampling obscured early detection.

vik: Follow-ups: add preflight for rotation job to verify IAM bindings exist on target key, enforce ordering so key promotion completes before TLS profile switches, avoid dropping mtls sampling below 80% for production regions.

mona: I'll file a PR to add an integration test that simulates rotation + policy rollout ordering.

compliance-bot: Reminder: attach sampling window and lost event estimate to INC-2026-058.

ana: Thanks team. Keeping incident open until coverage stable and postmortem done. :white_check_mark:
